purpose: Qualify the eight-active-slot Q8 TP1 queued HTTP profile on two fresh servers after its pilot removed the p16 aggregate-throughput collapse.

identity.topology: TP1 on one Intel Arc Pro B70

measurement.required_output_gate: 128 complete raw token IDs per response, zero reused prompt tokens, and no generated token digest equal to a frozen sequential oracle from another base task
measurement.required_stability_gate: both fresh attempts pass; relative range at every point <=10%
measurement.sequential_identity: reported but not required because greedy output may vary with batch shape

publication.aggregate: median of the two fresh-server aggregate tok/s values at each exact incoming concurrency
publication.latency_boundary: aggregate batch wall throughput only; this campaign does not qualify queued TTFT or per-request latency
